about: I'm Gonna Put Some Dirt in Your Eye is a close-up of Tobey Maguire as Peter Parker during his symbiote-influenced phase in Spider-Man 3 (2007). He stares straight at the camera with a smug, slightly unhinged look, a dark emo fringe hanging over his forehead, and a subtitle at the bottom reads "I'm gonna put some dirt in your eye." The threat is so weirdly specific and petty that it is funny rather than scary, which makes the image a reply to anyone who has said something mildly annoying.
origin: The image belongs to the Bully Maguire craze, in which fans remixed the emo, cocky version of Peter from Spider-Man 3 into absurd bully scenes and threats. The subtitled frame spread as a reaction image from those edits.
usage:
The single caption box sits above Peter. Write the offense that earns the threat, usually framed as what the other person just said or did: "you said my code was messy". The built-in subtitle is the response, so your line only has to set up why Peter is upset.

It is funniest when the offense is trivial: criticizing a playlist, correcting a typo, beating him in a casual game, saying a favorite movie is overrated. The pettier the crime, the better the overly personal punishment lands.
ideas: you said my code was messy
you skipped my song on aux
you said spider-man 3 was the worst one
you corrected my grammar in the group chat
you picked my main in ranked
you ate my leftovers from the office fridge
aka: I'm Gonna Put Some Dirt in Your Eye
